reviewNotes: Twenty-five item requests, body-part remedy fragments, urgent delivery notices, paid-fetch requests, greetings, and delivery confirmation were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placeholders, the rewritten neutral remedy template, leading and trailing spaces, dynamic item grammar, urgency and payment meaning, punctuation, and natural notice-board voice; both found no remaining objective issue.
